title: Patch: the cosmetic offers and the full-screen art's music load after the first page
notes: The first page load no longer ships the cosmetic offers or the music player (#4714, part 6 of #4691). COSMETIC_OFFERS moved to its own generated module, wire/generated/cosmeticOffers.ts, which cards/versions.ts loads with loadSceneData() (EngineGate, useEngineReady and the shop's route chunk wait for it), and cards/FullScreenArt.tsx loads the music player when the full-screen view opens; the engine module's boot fetch goes at low priority. First load: 383,498 to 366,513 B gzip. Nothing visible changes. Claims --visual because the change touches apps/web/src/cards/ (R2529000), a micro of no family.
